en: Typhoon Haiyan, known locally as Yolanda, was one of the strongest tropical cyclones ever recorded to make landfall.
Talc is officially ranked as number one, making it the softest mineral on the Mohs hardness scale.

Olympus Mons on Mars is a shield volcano standing about twenty-two kilometers high, the solar system's tallest mountain.
Sirius, also called the Dog Star, is the brightest star visible in the Earth's night sky.
The Apollo 11 astronauts landed their lunar module in the Sea of Tranquility on July 20, 1969.
The Amihan, or northeast monsoon, brings cool and dry air to the Philippines between November and February.
The fertile volcanic soil surrounding Mount Mayon in Albay is highly productive for growing abaca and rice.
The 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo released massive amounts of sulfur dioxide that temporarily cooled global temperatures.
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a massive, persistent anticyclonic storm that is larger than the planet Earth.
The troposphere is the lowest layer of Earth's atmosphere, where almost all weather phenomena and clouds form.
Laguna de Bay collects surface runoff from surrounding provinces, acting as a massive natural basin in the water cycle.
